title: ElektroPilot fictional validation set
notice: Fictional cases for software review only. Not field instructions and not proof of diagnostic accuracy.

cases.title: Intermittent RCD trip
cases.condition: Occurs when several appliances are in use
cases.scope: Several circuits downstream of one RCD
cases.confirmedFacts: Trip is reported by user; cause not verified
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool make uncertainty and missing evidence clear?

cases.title: Circuit without function
cases.scope: One circuit; exact affected points not yet mapped
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool avoid assuming a specific fault location?

cases.title: Unusually high energy consumption
cases.symptom: Energy use appears higher than expected
cases.condition: Comparison period and occupancy may differ
cases.confirmedFacts: Concern about consumption; cause not verified
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool ask for comparable data before suggesting causes?

cases.title: Conflicting evidence
cases.measurements: Measurements and conditions are not documented
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool avoid overconfident ranking?

cases.title: Insufficient evidence
cases.confirmedFacts: Only a vague report is available
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool request missing information rather than fabricate a diagnosis?

cases.title: Stop and escalate
cases.symptom: Visible damage or signs of overheating reported
cases.confirmedFacts: Damage reported but not independently assessed
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the workflow clearly prioritize stopping and qualified assessment?

cases.title: Unverified measurement
cases.symptom: A reading appears inconsistent with expected behavior
cases.condition: Instrument setup and test conditions unknown
cases.confirmedFacts: A number was reported; validity unknown
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool flag measurement validity as unresolved?

cases.title: Historical fault
cases.symptom: A fault occurred yesterday but cannot now be reproduced
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool distinguish past observations from current evidence?

cases.title: Multiple plausible causes
cases.condition: More than one load may be involved
cases.confirmedFacts: Behavior is reported but cause unknown
cases.reviewQuestion: Are alternative hypotheses presented without implying certainty?

cases.title: Confounded energy comparison
cases.symptom: Energy use increased month to month
cases.reviewQuestion: Does the tool identify confounding factors and request comparable data?
